title: Private Luxury Captained 3-Hour Pontoon Boat Cruise (2-11 Guests)
blurb:
We offer luxury boat tours complete with a captain to drive the boat! Chartering a captained 22ft luxury pontoon boat with friends and family is THE THING TO DO in the Okanagan! Imagine the wind blowing in your hair as we leisurely cruise past postcard wine country scenery and beautiful homes. Skip the crowded beaches and let us anchor in one of the private bays so you can relax or go swimming. Bring your picnic and beverages and get ready for an amazing day on the water! We will handle the rest! 

You can book this tour for up to 11 GUESTS in your party and includes FUEL! Perfect for all ages

9:45am-12:45pm Start the Morning off Right Cruise

1pm-4pm Fun in the Sun Afternoon Cruise

6pm-9pm Evening Delight Sunset Cruise
